daily.today_energy: The Sun in your sign is getting a solid trine from Saturn, so you're feeling grounded and purposeful instead of your usual scattered energy. This is actually the vibe you need to get real stuff done without burning out.
daily.love: Venus is squaring the Moon today, which might make you feel a little disconnected from your usual charm. It's not bad—just take things slower and let people know what you actually need instead of assuming they get it.
daily.career: Mars is hanging with Jupiter, amplifying your ability to take decisive action. Combined with that Sun-Saturn trine, you've got the focus to push a project forward. This is your moment to make a real move.
daily.health: Your energy is steady but not explosive today. Use this balanced vibe for sustainable habits rather than intense workouts. A regular routine will serve you better than going all-in.

weekly.overview: Sagittarius, this week is your solar return spotlight—you're literally glowing as the Sun moves through your sign. Early week, the Moon in Taurus grounds your fire energy with practical wins. Midweek, Mars conjuncts Jupiter in Leo, amplifying your confidence and magnetism. By the weekend, Mars shifts into Virgo, nudging you toward detail-oriented action. Best Day: Wednesday. Watch-Out Day: Friday (Sun squares Mars—don't let impatience derail you).
weekly.love: Venus sextiles Jupiter midweek, making you irresistible. If you're single, this is your golden window to put yourself out there—your charm is hitting different. Coupled? This transit softens edges and deepens connection. Friday's Sun-Mars square might bring minor friction, but it's just asking you to slow down and listen instead of steamrolling ahead.
weekly.career: Mars conjuncts Jupiter early-to-midweek: this is your power move moment. Launch projects, pitch ideas, ask for that raise. Your confidence is warranted. By Friday, Mars transitions into Virgo, shifting your energy from 'go big' to 'get precise.' Perfect timing to refine strategies and handle admin tasks you've been dodging. This combo sets you up for real momentum.
weekly.health: The Moon's journey from Taurus to Leo fuels your vitality early week. Ride that wave with movement you actually enjoy—not punishment workouts. Friday's Sun-Mars tension might spike stress or restlessness; counteract with grounding practices like stretching or time outside. Mars in Virgo later demands cleaner routines, so this is the week to pivot habits naturally.
